title: Open Source Model/LLM+what Harness/providers?
author: HereToLearn321
selftext:
I know many of you are on Codex and Claude desktop apps via the max plans for the coding side. But I'm wondering for those who are more budget conscious (since it seems now 80% of usage are open models) if you've found a harness+open source provider that works for you for say some of the more basic tasks?

  
Astra is quite expensive, but I don't always need Opus 5.5 or Astra levels. More like Luna/Sol/Sonnet 5. 

  
Any recommendations, I mostly use Unity but open to doing prototypes with three.js/godot if I can do them on the "downtime" with a MUCH cheaper set of models. My main worry is the harnesses are not as good?

  
TLDR:

1) what open harness are yo uusing

2) what open model are you using 

3) what service/cloud provider are you using (i have 8gb gpu ram only,sadly)

comments.author: -Star-Walker-
comments.body:
Keep an eye on LM Studio Bionic, combined with QWEN3.8 27b (locally) it’s coding quality surpasses at least Claude Sonnet (by far). 

Problem: You can’t use any OpenAI compatible service (for now), only local and some models hosted by them (with a paid subscription). But I think, they will add the ability to use other services in near future.

comments.author: Neither-Upstairs
comments.body: I’ve been trying hard to not use any of the frontier providers and to develop games using Unity and a local model. It’s been a real challenge trying to set up a workflow that actually works. I’m still new to all of the AI terminology so I don’t exactly know how things should be set up. So far I have something like: Ollama serving a qwen model -> into Claude code -> Unity cli (via Unity pipeline). It doesn’t work lol.
